Recovering deleted Azure AD Conditional Access policies involves **Microsoft 365 unified audit log (UAL) analysis** and **Azure AD Graph API snapshots**.
```kql
AzureActivity
| where OperationName == "Delete conditional access policy"
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, OperationName, _ResourceId
```
For deeper recovery, access **Azure AD Change Logs** via **PowerShell**:
```powershell
Get-MgAuditLogDirectory -DirectoryId "<tenant-id>" | Where-Object {$_.OperationName -eq "ConditionalAccessPolicy"}
```
